prompt: Six-second silent photographic product video, landscape 16:9. A realistic lived-in home office with a natural oak desk, fine visible wood grain, soft window daylight, natural shadows, a softly blurred plain bookshelf and a small green plant behind the desk. The camera looks STRAIGHT ON at the desk, perpendicular to its front edge, with the desk edge horizontal across the image. Three unbranded devices are side by side in a perfectly straight horizontal row, not diagonal: LEFT a silver 14-inch aluminum laptop facing squarely toward the viewer, CENTER charcoal over-ear headphones standing upright, RIGHT a small ordinary symmetrical charcoal computer mouse. Their front edges align along the same horizontal line on the desk, with clear empty gaps and no overlap. The laptop sits entirely to the left of the headphones; the mouse sits entirely to the right of them. The laptop is open at 110 degrees and stays still. Its screen shows only a smooth neutral grey-to-teal gradient: no UI, text, icons, menus or symbols. Devices have blank unbranded surfaces. A plain ivory coffee mug sits behind and left of the laptop, outside the three-device row. Wide composition with generous empty space around every object; nothing cropped. Locked-off camera and stationary objects throughout, no orbit, pan, push-in, cuts or opening animation. Realistic product proportions, aluminum reflections, matte headphones and natural materials, not a CGI showroom. No people, hands or faces. No visible writing on books or background surfaces; book spines face away. No logos, labels, signage, numbers, branding, recognizable trade dress or soundtrack.
